resources.string: Turn this phone into a fixed test point for a second BLE receiver. The beacon has no automatic time limit: stop it here or from its notification.
Stop is not confirmed. Try Stop again or turn Bluetooth off. The radio remains reserved until cleanup is confirmed.

1. Enable Bluetooth and tap Start beacon.
2. On a second device, scan all BLE advertisements and inspect service data.
3. Match the service UUID and test ID below, then follow the RSSI measured by that receiver.
4. Tap Stop when finished.

This custom test format requires an all-BLE view or a compatible decoder. Nano and FC65 filters alone will not identify it.

Service UUID
%1$s

Service data (hex)
%2$s

Version 01 + 8 identity bytes. Legacy 1M; requested interval 200 ms; requested power −7 dBm. No device name, manufacturer data or GATT service.

Controller acceptance confirms the Android request, not independent radio reception. Use a second receiver to verify the signal. RSSI does not prove distance or direction.

The foreground session can continue with the screen off. Android, device battery restrictions, permission changes, Bluetooth being turned off, force-stop or reboot can interrupt it. After an interruption, start again explicitly.

The test ID is random and stored locally for this app installation. It is public over the air, not an authentication token or the phone Bluetooth address. Clearing app data creates a new ID. This mode does not change the phone Bluetooth name.
Notifications are off. The beacon can run, but the notification Stop action may be hidden. Keep this screen available, or enable notifications in Android settings.
Continuous beacon status with an explicit Stop action
Stopped: Bluetooth advertising permission is missing. Grant Nearby devices permission before trying again.
Stopped: Bluetooth is off or unavailable. Turn it on, then start again.
Stopped: this device does not support the required BLE advertising mode.
The radio is in use by a capture or simulation. Stop that session first.
Stopped: Android did not confirm beacon startup in time.
The local beacon state could not be safely loaded or saved. No new beacon was started.
Radio cleanup is confirmed, but the saved session status could not be cleared. Reopening the app may report an interruption.
Android could not start the visible beacon service. Check Bluetooth permissions, then start again from this screen.
The beacon was interrupted before a confirmed stop. Check Bluetooth and start again explicitly.
Stopped: the Bluetooth controller rejected or interrupted the request. Check Bluetooth and try again.
